rest-pos.description:
Rest POS is a lightning-fast, 100% offline-first Point-of-Sale (POS)/ Billing and restaurant management application built specifically for Android phones and tablets. Designed with Google's modern Material 3 design system, Rest POS delivers buttery-smooth 60/120fps animations, tactile haptic feedback, and an ultra-intuitive touchscreen experience that speeds up your order checkout times by

3x.
